attributes.description: Overview of the TrueNAS system health alerts collected by the TrueNAS integration. TrueNAS only reports an alert when it is raised or when it recurs, so this dashboard shows the alerts raised in the selected time range, not the set of alerts that is currently active: no document is produced when an alert clears or is dismissed. Every panel is scoped to the truenas.alert dataset.

embeddableConfig.description: Number of times an alert was raised or recurred in the selected time range. This is not a count of currently active alerts.
event.severity runs from 1 (info) to 7 (emergency); higher is more severe. This panel counts severity 3 (warning) and above.
Distinct TrueNAS alert classes seen, for example ScrubFinished or VolumeStatus.

embeddableConfig.description: Ordered by event.severity, where 7 (emergency) is the most severe and 1 (info) the least.
The TrueNAS host name on a single-controller system, or the failover label Controller A / Controller B on an HA pair.

Grouped by truenas.alert.text, the unrendered alert template, which is identical for every occurrence of an alert class. The text rendered for a single occurrence is in message; open the Alerts raised Discover session to read it. Last raised is the most recent occurrence in the selected time range.
